prompt_text: Who was the king in France in 2020?
response_text: There was **no king in France in 2020**. France is a republic, and its head of state is the President. In 2020, the President of France was **Emmanuel Macron** (he has been in office since May 2017). The last monarch of France was King Louis‑Philippe I, who reigned until the monarchy was abolished in 1848.
